DECLARE @startDate AS Datetime = ?; 
SET @startDate = DATEADD(DD,-1,@startDate)

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

WITH Scan AS (
    SELECT LabelNo, max(UploadDate) as UploadDate
    FROM [FastwayReports].[dbo].[TrackAndTraceDataP] WITH (NOLOCK)
    WHERE UploadDate > @startDate 
    AND ScanDate >= DATEADD(Month,-1,GETDATE())
    AND CountryCode IN (1,6,11,24)
    GROUP BY LabelNo
)

SELECT 
       Label.[LabelNo]
      ,[CountryCode]
      ,[Electronic_CustomerType]
      ,[Electronic_CustomerID]
      ,[Electronic_Reference]
      ,[FastLabel_ConsignmentID]
      ,[FastLabel_DestinationRF]
      ,[Distribution_Date]
      ,[Distribution_FranchiseeCode]
      ,[KPI_PickupOK]
      ,[KPI_DeliveryOK]
      ,[KPI_LatePickup]
      ,[KPI_LateDelivery]
      ,[KPI_DelRF]
      ,[KPI_PicRF]
      ,[FMSCustomerID]
      ,[FMSRfID]
      ,[OES_CustomerId]
      ,[KPI_ExpectedDelivery]
      ,[KPI_ExceptionScan]
      ,[PrintedOn]
      ,[EbayClickCollect]
      ,[HasSubscriptions]
      ,Scan.[UploadDate]
FROM [FastwayReports].[dbo].[LabelMaster] AS Label
JOIN Scan ON Scan.LabelNo = Label.LabelNo 
WHERE CountryCode IN (1,6,11,24) ;

DECLARE @startDate datetime = ?

--SET @StartDate = '2022-06-01T00:00:00'

	d.LabelNumber, 
	d.CountryCode, 
	d.CreateDate,

	d.CustomerID, 
	d.ClientID, 
	d.ConsumedByCustomerUserID, 
	d.LblColour, 
	d.LblPrice, 
	d.LblPrice1,
	i.Reference, 
	i.Packaging, 
	i.Weight, 
	i.WeightCubic, 
	i.Length, 
	i.Width, 
	i.Height, 
	b.ManifestID, 
	b.Address1,
	b.Address2,
	b.Town, 
	b.PostCode, 
	b.State, 
	b.destRF,
	d.BookID,
                  d.DateConsumed,

LEFT JOIN [OnlineEnquiries_NEW].[dbo].[tblFastLabel_Consignment] b on i.ConsignmentID = b.ConsignmentID

DECLARE @startDate datetime = ?

SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;

SELECT 
       cl.LabelNumber,
       cl.CountryId,
       cm.WebCustomerId,
       c.CustomerId,
       c.ReceiverContactName,
       c.ReceiverCompanyName,
       c.ReceiverAddress1,
       c.ReceiverAddress2,
       c.ReceiverSuburb,
       c.ReceiverCity,
       c.ReceiverPostcode,
       c.SpecialInstructions,
       c.ReceiverPhone,
       c.ReceiverEmail,
       cl.PrintedOn, 
       ci.Reference,
       c.DestinationRF,
       c.ManifestId,
       c.Price,
       cl.InvoiceNo,
       c.ItemCount,
       cl.CreatedOn,
       ci.WeightCubic,
       ci.WeightDead,
       ci.Width,
       ci.Length,
       ci.Height,
       cl.Colour,
       cl.ConsignmentItemId
FROM FastLabelServer.dbo.Consignment c 
JOIN FastLabelServer.dbo.ConsignmentItem ci on c.CountryId = ci.CountryId and c.CustomerId = ci.CustomerId and c.Id = ci.ConsignmentId
JOIN FastLabelServer.dbo.ConsignmentLabel cl on ci.CountryId = cl.CountryId and ci.CustomerId = cl.CustomerId and ci.Id = cl.ConsignmentItemId
LEFT JOIN FastLabelServer.dbo.CustomerMap cm on c.CountryId = cm.CountryId and c.CustomerId = cm.CustomerId 
WHERE cl.CreatedOn >@startDate ;
